request.conditions: Illustrative arithmetic batch of 100 attempts; no physical/simulation experiment

warnings: Completeness applies only to the declared boundary; capital investment and payback are not evaluated.
Results include planning assumptions, not exclusively measured performance.

simple_payback_years.reason: No positive recurring savings; compare horizon cost for lower-upfront/higher-running-cost tradeoffs

issues: candidate capacity cannot meet annual demand

limitations: Constant annual demand and linear variable cost; batch-size economies require separate representative inputs.
Undiscounted cost comparison; financing, tax, revenue, resale and replacement are not modeled.
Capacity uses nominal accepted rate × scheduled hours × utilization × (1 − downtime); avoid double-counting losses already in nominal rate.
Thresholds are continuous annual volumes; integer demand must be rounded and checked against both capacities.
Metrics can be calculated conditionally while decision remains blocked by evidence, capacity or horizon gates.
